instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Wealth management advisory serving 400+ high-net-worth families with holistic financial planning, tax optimization, and estate structuring. Blending in-person advisory with a client portal for portfolio tracking. Seeking to enhance client reporting with interactive scenario modeling tools. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We piloted a cloud-based project management tool last year, but adoption was inconsistent across teams and we ultimately reverted to spreadsheets and email for most project tracking. The experience highlighted that tool adoption requires more structured change management than we initially planned for.
answers.strategicGoals: Cost reduction and process optimization are our dominant strategic priorities. Our industry is experiencing margin compression due to rising input costs and price-sensitive customers. We need to systematically identify and eliminate inefficiencies across procurement, production, logistics, and back-office functions. Every 1% of margin improvement directly impacts our ability to reinvest in growth.
answers.teamSize: The innovation function is informal — one senior engineer has been given permission to spend 30% of their time exploring new technologies and prototyping ideas, but this allocation is frequently interrupted by production incidents and urgent feature requests. We have no dedicated innovation budget beyond standard cloud infrastructure costs.

input.changes_since_last: Acquired 2 new enterprise clients. Expanded into adjacent market. Digital maturity improving.

opportunities.title: Implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for Client Lifecycle Management
opportunities.rationale: The transition from founder-led to scalable operations requires formalized processes, especially in key functions like client onboarding and reporting. Refining the SOPs ensures consistency across newly acquired clients and helps reduce reliance on tribal knowledge.

first_actions: Map current state workflows for the top 3 most frequent client interactions (e.g., Quarterly Review, New Onboarding).
Define standardized templates and mandatory checkpoints within these critical processes.
Pilot the SOPs with a small group of high-performing team members to gather early feedback.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in client onboarding time by 20% within six months.
milestones: Completion of process mapping for core functions.
Drafting and approval of 5 key SOPs.

opportunities.title: Develop Centralized Data Layer for Predictive Client Reporting
opportunities.rationale: Reliance on disparate systems (ad-hoc integration) is a critical bottleneck to achieving efficiency and providing advanced, interactive scenario modeling. A centralized data layer will break down silos and feed accurate insights into the client portal.

first_actions: Identify the core data entities required for scenario modeling (e.g., tax inputs, market indices, portfolio performance).
Conduct a gap analysis between current systems and necessary integration points.
Prototype an ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) pipeline using existing cloud resources.
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful automated ingestion of three distinct systems into a single reporting dashboard.
milestones: Pilot integration connecting two core systems (e.g., CRM to Portfolio Tool).
Dashboard running on live, combined data feed.

next_steps.action: Initiate a formal Process Mapping workshop involving key stakeholders to identify the top 3 efficiency pain points and their current workflow bottlenecks.
Establish a recurring 'Optimization Review' meeting cadence (bi-weekly) to prioritize necessary quick wins and ensure SOP development remains aligned with immediate cost reduction goals.
Develop a formal, phased request process for integrating new tech solutions, requiring clear ROI metrics and resource allocation estimates before starting implementation.

key_weaknesses: Informal adherence to processes, leading to inconsistent client experience during scaling (Process Gap).
Ad-hoc reliance on system integration and manual data transfers across core platforms.
Resource allocation for innovation remains vulnerable to urgent production incidents, preventing dedicated time for structured improvements.

improvements: Digital Maturity increased from Level 2 to Level 3, demonstrating growing technical capability and adoption of basic tools.
Increased revenue and expanded market reach (acquisition of 2 enterprise clients) validates operational growth and necessity for formalizing processes.
persistent_gaps: The core barrier remains procedural and cultural: lack of standardized process ownership and formalized change management protocols.
System integration is still brittle, preventing the realization of advanced predictive modeling capabilities necessary for margin improvement.
achieved_milestones: Successful navigation of expanded market segments indicates growth resilience.
The dedicated time allocation (30%) exists and was utilized to complete step 3, suggesting initial momentum in capability building.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Increased digital maturity and successful client acquisition validate market need and growth trajectory. The shift in focus from initial capability building to systemic efficiency optimization is required due to margin compression pressures.
